Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to the most common questions from our international clients.

What is the minimum order quantity?

The minimum order varies by product. For cacao beans, the MOQ is 1 metric ton. Contact us for customized quotes based on your needs.

What certifications do your products have?

We hold USDA Organic, Fair Trade, HACCP, ISO 22000 certifications, and active SENASA registration. All available for verification.

What are the shipping times?

Maritime transit time ranges from 25-45 days depending on the destination port. We ship via the ports of Callao and Paita.

Do you offer free samples?

Yes, we provide free samples for qualified potential clients. Shipping costs are covered by the buyer.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept advance payment via bank transfer (SWIFT), irrevocable letter of credit, and partial payments for clients with purchase history.
